description: The line plot titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = small" illustrates the performance of different configurations of the Whisper model over a series of epochs. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," is linear and ranges from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis, labeled "WER," is also linear and ranges from 25.0 to 42.5, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The plot includes four lines representing different configurations: "small AdaLoRA_int4," "small AdaLoRA_int8," "small int4," and "small int8." The "small AdaLoRA_int4" line is a solid line with circle markers, starting at approximately 35.0 WER at epoch 0 and ending at around 30.0 WER at epoch 6. The "small AdaLoRA_int8" line is a dashed line with square markers, beginning at about 40.0 WER and decreasing to roughly 30.0 WER. The "small int4" line is a solid line with circle markers, starting at around 30.0 WER and ending at about 27.5 WER. The "small int8" line is a dashed line with square markers, beginning at approximately 35.0 WER and decreasing to around 25.0 WER. The plot shows a general trend of decreasing WER as the number of epochs increases for all configurations.
